scope: Local SQLite inbox exactness and paired scaling on deterministic fixtures; no model/token/e2e claims

implementation.procedure: Read baseline/candidate source and actual public methods; immutable events/ACK/budget/evidence preserved
implementation.acceptance: Only pending index added; source and regressions verified

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare baseline/candidate to independently derived sequences and JSON at every case
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact equality, restart and migration preserved

data_integrity.procedure: Check cases, 21 paired samples, 3 warmups and all failures, bound source/environment
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/duplicate cases; raw finite data

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians, VM-step ratios, validate units

measurement_validity.procedure: Alternating paired order; time public inbox including connect/JSON without progress handler; VM measured separately; overhead/migration separate
measurement_validity.acceptance: >=2x VM reduction at one-run 20k history; publish/ACK <=2x or <1ms added median; migration <10s

reproducibility.procedure: Independent verifier reruns bounded benchmark and tests
reproducibility.acceptance: Exact output and scoped VM threshold reproduce
